<a id="room_map_17"></a>
### [`room_map_17`](../../../src/room_maps_15_19.asm#L75) `$7D8D-$7E8F`

*data*

Map of room 17, $7D8D-$7E8F (259 bytes), RLE stream (format at room_map_00). Charset: room_charset_b ($A800, D018 $3A). It decodes to 442 tiles, 2 more than 40x11: the extra $00 tiles land on $8FE8-$8FE9 and $9010-$9011 (bottom half $80), which corrupts 2 bytes of the collision mask of Bruce frame 0.

- **Entry of:** [`room_map_ptr_lo`](../tables.md#room_map_ptr_lo)
